from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a party involved in the legal case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The legal role, e.g., Appellant, Defendant, Reconsideration Applicant")

class FinancialDetail(BaseModel):
    """Represents a monetary amount or fee mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the amount")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The type of amount, e.g., case fee, fine, smuggling tax")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears or pays this amount, if specified")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., Yuan, RMB")

class DocumentMatchFeatures(BaseModel):
    """Captures the unique identifiers of a legal document to enable matching against judgment results."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The full case reference number")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The category of the case, e.g., Civil Appeal, Criminal Second Instance")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling conclusion text")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of all parties involved in the document")
    financials: list[FinancialDetail] = Field(description="List of monetary amounts and fees detailed in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extracted features for all legal documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentMatchFeatures]
